description: Search published Collectorists catalogue records (coins, trading cards, sports cards, stamps, LEGO® sets and other toys, comics, sealed products) by words. Returns each match's title, type, a few identifying facts and its page on collectorists.com. Returns no prices, listings or images.

limit.description: How many records to return, best match first.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "1887 shilling", "Peter Rabbit 50p", "Millennium Falcon".

type.description: Optional: limit to one kind of item.

name: search_catalogue
title: Search the catalogue
